```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(binom)

# some general data preparations for simulation results
prepare_sim_results <- function(d_sim) {
  
  d_sim <- within(d_sim, {
    scenario_num <- scenario;
    scenario <- paste0("Scenario ", scenario);
    estimator <- factor(
      estimator,
      levels = c("cox", "cco", "ctc", "sccs", "sccs_spline_5",
                 "sccs_spline_15", "spmd"),
      labels = c("Cox", "CCO", "CTC", "SCCS", "SCCS\nSpline\n(5)",
                 "SCCS\nSpline\n(15)", "SPM")
    );
    exp_theta <- exp(theta);
    exp_theta_f <- factor(
      exp_theta,
      levels = c("0.7", "1", "1.5", "2.5", "5"),
      labels = c(expression(exp(theta)~`=`~0.7),
                 expression(exp(theta)~`=`~1),
                 expression(exp(theta)~`=`~1.5),
                 expression(exp(theta)~`=`~2.5),
                 expression(exp(theta)~`=`~5))
    );
    beta_L_A_f <- factor(
      exp(beta_L_A),
      levels = c("1", "3", "5"),
      labels = c(expression(exp(beta[A])~`=`~1),
                 expression(exp(beta[A])~`=`~3),
                 expression(exp(beta[A])~`=`~5))
    );
    beta_L_Y_f <- factor(
      exp(beta_L_Y),
      levels = c("1", "3", "5"),
      labels = c(expression(exp(beta[Y])~`=`~1),
                 expression(exp(beta[Y])~`=`~3),
                 expression(exp(beta[Y])~`=`~5))
    );
    risk_period_f <- factor(
      risk_period,
      levels = c("10", "50", "100", "150", "300"),
      labels = c(expression(tau~`=`~10),
                 expression(tau~`=`~50),
                 expression(tau~`=`~100),
                 expression(tau~`=`~150),
                 expression(tau~`=`~300))
    );
    log_bias_i <- log(rr_hat) - theta;
    log_mse_i <- (log(rr_hat) - theta)^2;
    exp_beta_L_A <- exp(beta_L_A);
    exp_beta_L_Y <- exp(beta_L_Y);
  })
  
  d_sim <- as.data.table(d_sim)
  
  # event and other counts were only made for estimator="spmd", so fill the
  # rest of the rows with the same (equivalent) info
  d_sim[, n_events := min(n_events, na.rm=TRUE),
        by=c("rep_id", "scenario", "theta", "n", "multiple_A", "multiple_Y",
             "beta_L_Y", "beta_L_A", "U_time_interact", "A_time_interact",
             "conf_int", "risk_period")]
  d_sim[, n_exposed_and_event := min(n_exposed_and_event, na.rm=TRUE),
        by=c("rep_id", "scenario", "theta", "n", "multiple_A", "multiple_Y",
             "beta_L_Y", "beta_L_A", "U_time_interact", "A_time_interact",
             "conf_int", "risk_period")]
  
  # remove rows where rr = 0
  d_sim <- subset(d_sim, !(rr_hat==0))
  
  return(d_sim)
}

## simple boxplots for each estimator and scenario
plot_boxplots_n <- function(data, outliers=FALSE) {
  
  # colourblind-friendly colours (six estimators)
  estimator_levels <- levels(droplevels(data$estimator))
  estimator_cols <- setNames(
    c(
      "#0072B2",  # Blue
      "#E69F00",  # Orange
      "#009E73",  # Bluish green
      "#D55E00",  # Vermillion
      "#56B4E9",  # Sky blue
      "#CC79A7"   # Reddish purple
    ), estimator_levels
  )

  p <- ggplot(data=data, aes(x=estimator, y=log_bias_i, fill=estimator)) +
    # reference line
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.45,
               colour="grey25") +
    # boxplots
    geom_boxplot(outliers=outliers, width=0.68, linewidth=0.35, colour="grey20",
                 alpha=0.85, outlier.size=0.7) +
    # consistent colours across all panels
    scale_fill_manual(values=estimator_cols, drop=FALSE) +
    # faceting
    facet_grid(
      rows = vars(exp_theta_f),
      cols = vars(scenario),
      labeller = labeller(
        exp_theta_f = label_parsed,
        scenario = label_value
      ),
      scales="free_y"
    ) +
    # some breathing room around the data
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.04, 0.08))) +
    # theme
    theme_minimal(base_size=9, base_family="sans") +
    theme(
      # remove unnecessary elements
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      # subtle horizontal gridlines
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour="#E3E6E8", linewidth=0.3),
      # panel separation
      panel.border = element_rect(colour="#D9DDE1", fill=NA, linewidth=0.35),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.9, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.7, "lines"),
      # facet labels
      strip.background = element_rect(fill="#F0F2F4", colour=NA),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size=9, face="bold", colour="#252525",
                                  margin=margin(t=5, b=5)),
      strip.text.y.right = element_text(size=8.5, face="bold", angle=0,
                                        colour="#252525",
                                        margin=margin(l=5, r=5)),
      strip.placement="outside",
      # axis labels
      axis.text.x = element_text(size=7.5, #angle=40, hjust=1, vjust=1,
                                 colour="#333333"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, colour="#333333"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size=9, colour="#252525", margin=margin(r=8)),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      # white background and balanced margins
      panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill="white", colour=NA),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    ) +
    labs(x=NULL, y=expression(hat(theta) - theta))
  
  return(p)
}

## create a table of bias, MSE and associated MCSE by n / theta / scenario
get_stats_table <- function(d_sim, n_repeats=1000) {
  
  # remove infinite or NA values
  d_bias <- copy(as.data.table(d_sim))
  d_bias <- subset(d_bias, is.finite(rr_hat) & !is.na(rr_hat))
  
  # identify variables that were varied
  all_vars <- c("n", "exp_beta_L_Y", "exp_beta_L_A", "scenario_num", "estimator",
                "exp_theta", "multiple_A", "multiple_Y", "U_time_interact",
                "A_time_interact", "conf_int", "risk_period", "allow_overlap",
                "censor")
  varies <- apply(d_bias[, all_vars, with=FALSE], 2, function(x){uniqueN(x) > 1})
  all_vars <- all_vars[varies]
  
  # calculate performance stats
  d_bias[, n_valid := sum(!is.na(rr_hat)), by=eval(all_vars)]
  
  d_bias <- d_bias[,
    .(bias = mean(log(rr_hat) - theta, na.rm=TRUE),
      bias_mcse = sd(log(rr_hat) - theta, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(n_valid[1]),
      mse = mean((log(rr_hat) - theta)^2, na.rm=TRUE),
      mse_mcse = sd((log(rr_hat) - theta)^2, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(n_valid[1]),
      n_events = mean(n_events),
      n_events_exp = mean(n_exposed_and_event),
      n_NA = n_repeats - .N),
    by=eval(all_vars)
  ]

  setkeyv(d_bias, all_vars)
  
  # put Bias / MSE and their MCSE in one columns
  d_bias[, `Bias [MCSE]` := paste0(round(bias, 3), " [", round(bias_mcse, 3), "]")]
  d_bias[, `MSE [MCSE]` := paste0(round(mse, 3), " [", round(mse_mcse, 3), "]")]
  d_bias[estimator=="SCCS\nSpline\n(5)", estimator := "SCCS Spline (5)"]
  d_bias[estimator=="SCCS\nSpline\n(15)", estimator := "SCCS Spline (15)"]
  d_bias[, c("bias", "bias_mcse", "mse", "mse_mcse") := NULL]
  
  # change column order
  setcolorder(d_bias,
              neworder=c(all_vars, "Bias [MCSE]", "MSE [MCSE]", "n_events",
                         "n_events_exp", "n_NA"))
  
  # change column names
  setnames(d_bias,
           old=c("exp_beta_L_Y", "exp_beta_L_A", "exp_theta", "risk_period",
                 "n_events", "n_events_exp", "n_NA", "scenario_num",
                 "estimator"),
           new=c("exp(beta_Y)", "exp(beta_A)", "exp(theta)",
                 "tau", "n_Y", "n_YA", "n NA",
                 "Scenario", "Estimator"),
           skip_absent=TRUE)
  
  return(d_bias)
}

## prints out the table of statistics
print_stats <- function(d_bias, format="html") {
  knitr::kable(d_bias, format=format, booktabs=TRUE, digits=3, linesep="",
               longtable=TRUE)
}
```

# Introduction

This script takes in the results generated using the Monte-Carlo simulation and analyzes them, creating the plots and tables shown in the paper and its appendices. To reproduce these results, first execute the `run_simulation.r` script. Only then this markdown document may be created.

```{r}
# read in simulation results
d_sim1 <- readRDS("./data/sim1_results.Rds") # TODO: run
d_sim2 <- readRDS("./data/sim2_results.Rds") # TODO: run
```

# Bootstrap CI Coverage

```{r}
d_sim5[, in_ci := exp_theta >= ci_lower & exp_theta <= ci_upper]
d_sim5[, ci_length := ci_upper - ci_lower]
d_sim5[, signif := (ci_lower < 1 & ci_upper < 1) | (ci_lower > 1 & ci_upper > 1)]

d_sim5_est <- d_sim5[, .(
  coverage = sum(in_ci) / .N,
  coverage_lower = binom.confint(x=sum(in_ci), n=.N, methods="exact")$lower,
  coverage_upper = binom.confint(x=sum(in_ci), n=.N, methods="exact")$upper,
  power = mean(signif),
  power_lower = binom.confint(x=sum(signif), n=.N, methods="exact")$lower,
  power_upper = binom.confint(x=sum(signif), n=.N, methods="exact")$upper,
  mean_boot_na = mean(boot_na),
  n_NA = 1000 - .N
), by=c("n", "scenario", "estimator", "exp_theta", "conf_int")  
]
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(subset(d_sim5_est, conf_int=="boot.fast")[, -"conf_int"], format="html")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(subset(d_sim5_est, conf_int=="jackknife")[, -c("conf_int", "boot_na")], format="html")
```
